previewText: Gwinnett and DeKalb County market snapshot for August 2026, Easy Apple Salad and Gwinnett Public Safety Fall Festival, and a short note from Danny.

paragraphs: September is moving right along, and the first hints of fall are starting to show up around Gwinnett.
This week I included an easy apple salad for busy days, a free family event with Gwinnett's first responders, and a quick look at the latest Gwinnett and DeKalb County market numbers.

market.title: Gwinnett and DeKalb County market snapshot for August 2026
market.source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data
paragraphs: In Gwinnett County, Realtor.com reported 3,828 active listings in August 2026, 11.4% higher from one year earlier. The median listing price was $450,000, and median days on market came in at 54 days, 5.9% higher year over year.

In DeKalb County, Realtor.com reported 3,082 active listings in August 2026, 15.7% lower from one year earlier. The median listing price was $332,500, and median days on market came in at 58 days, 3.3% lower year over year.

This month's contrast is worth watching: Gwinnett added inventory while DeKalb had fewer active listings than a year ago. If you are planning a move, the conditions on your street and in your price range deserve a closer look than the broad county averages alone.
market.verificationNote: Source: Realtor.com Economic Research county inventory data for August 2026. Verified counties available to this run: Gwinnett County, Barrow County, Walton County, Rockdale County, DeKalb County, Jackson County.

rotatingFeatures.label: RECIPE
rotatingFeatures.title: Easy Apple Salad
paragraphs: Georgia apples are in season, and this quick recipe works well as an after-school snack or an easy side.
items: Cut 2 tart apples into bite-size pieces.
Toss with 2 tablespoons dried cranberries or raisins, 3 tablespoons plain low-fat yogurt, and 1 tablespoon chopped nuts.
Add a little honey if you like it sweeter, then serve right away.
rotatingFeatures.closing: Simple, quick, and easy to adjust for your family.
rotatingFeatures.source: UGA Cooperative Extension, Ideas for Apples

rotatingFeatures.label: LOCAL COMMUNITY EVENT
rotatingFeatures.title: Gwinnett Public Safety Fall Festival
rotatingFeatures.availability: Saturday, September 12, 2026, 11:00 AM-3:00 PM; free admission
paragraphs: Gwinnett County is bringing local first responders, touch-a-trucks, safety exhibits, food, giveaways, demonstrations, and the Peach State Police Motorcycle Rodeo to Gwinnett Field. It is a free, family-friendly way to meet the people who help keep the community safe.
